title: spec/i18n: a report's label and description have no translation key — `os i18n check` reports 100 % with zero report keys while the console's Reports index shows every report in English under zh-CN
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named landing site** (the sibling of #25652, which added the key for positions and permission sets). Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What is seen (HotCRM on `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0, zh-CN)

- HotCRM → 报表 → 全部报表: all ten reports list with their authored English `label` and `description` ("Accounts by Industry and Type — Matrix report showing accounts by industry and type", "Opportunities by Stage — Summary of opportunities grouped by stage", …). The report page title does the same. [42-reports.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/42-reports.png), [94-report-opps-by-stage.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/94-report-opps-by-stage.png).
- The HotCRM navigation entries for the same reports are translated (「各阶段商机」 in the zh-CN pack), so the gap is the report item itself, not the app's packs.
- `pnpm exec objectstack i18n check` in HotCRM: `✓ All 1691 translation keys covered across 4 locale(s)` — no key for any of the ten reports' `label` or `description` is extracted, so an app author cannot translate them even if they want to.

`reach:` the public UI, measured once; `os i18n check` output, measured once on HotCRM `main` `a7faf81`.

## Expected

`os i18n extract` emits a key for each report's `label` and `description` (the shape #25652 used for positions and permission sets), `translateReport` (or the meta serving path) applies the bundle, and the console's Reports index and report page read the translated label. HotCRM then fills the four packs (its half, filed after a released `@objectstack/*` carries this).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectstack "report label and description have no translation surface i18n extract does not emit report keys" → 6 hits: #25652 (positions / permission sets, closed), #24968 (page tabs, closed), #24140 (line-item columns, closed), #21006 (embedded listViews, closed), objectstack-ai/objectui#5076 (analytics option labels, closed), #15984 (docs) — none covers report label / description. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §3.4.
